# TryIPTV

> TryIPTV is a prepaid IPTV subscription service offering live TV, sports, movies, series, and on-demand streaming with support for popular streaming devices and IPTV players.

Official website: https://www.tryiptv.com/

## Service Information

- Brand: TryIPTV
- Subscription model: prepaid
- Automatic renewal: no
- Trial: 24 hours
- Typical activation target: approximately 5–15 minutes
- Login methods: Xtream Codes API and M3U
- Simultaneous connections: 2
- 1 month: $16
- 3 months: $39
- 6 months: $60
- 12 months: $90
